focus.label: Mycosis fungoides, a cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
focus.why: The current frontier 'Cutaneous neoplasm/lymphoma' is too broad. This candidate refines it to the most common form of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma. The radiologist's TCR rearrangement recommendation (node-10) and both experts ranking neoplasm/lymphoma first (node-14) support a T-cell lymphoproliferative process; the refractory crusted plaque in an immunosuppressed woman is compatible with mycosis fungoides. Confidence is limited by unavailable histopathology (node-9) and pending molecular results (node-12).
